title: Refunds Policy for Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Refunds department policy statement.** A ticket of Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand is refunded to the original form of payment in three situations:

1. the fare brand is refundable and the customer asks to cancel;
2. Crestline cancelled a flight on the ticket, or made a significant schedule change to it, and the customer declines the rebooking offered;
3. the risk-free void applies.

## Significant schedule change

A significant schedule change moves a departure or arrival by at least the fare brand's domestic threshold in hours on a domestic itinerary, or its international threshold in hours on an international itinerary, measured by the arrival lateness recorded on the disruption record, with the threshold itself counting as significant.

## Involuntary refunds

- An involuntary refund requires a disruption record on an unflown segment of the ticket whose disruption type is cancellation or schedule change.
- A customer who accepts the rebooking has no refund right for that disruption. Whether the rebooking was accepted or declined is the customer's own statement about that disruption.
- An involuntary refund refunds the residual value, is available on every fare brand including Crestline Basic Economy, and the fees for services on the unflown segments are refunded alongside it under the fee-refund rule.

## Refundable-fare cancellation

A refundable-fare cancellation refunds the full residual value. A nonrefundable fare brand cancelled voluntarily is never refunded; it can only be cancelled for credit.

## Payout

- A refund payout is made only on a ticket whose status is voided or refunded.
- Refunds to a card are processed within the fare brand's card processing time in business days, and other forms within its processing time in calendar days.
- A ticket paid with award miles has its miles returned through the Summit award redeposit rule instead, and the portion of a ticket paid with a flight credit is re-issued as a flight credit rather than paid out.

| Hypothetical case | Refund to original payment |
|---|---|
| Crestline Main Flexible, customer cancels | Yes, full residual value |
| Crestline Main Cabin, customer cancels, no disruption | No; cancellation for credit only |
| Crestline Basic Economy, flight cancelled by Crestline, rebooking declined | Yes, residual value plus fees on unflown segments |
| Any brand, flight cancelled, rebooking accepted | No refund right for that disruption |
